question: Y takes five days more than X to finish a work. Working together, they finish the work in six days. In how many days can Y finish it working alone?
solution:

Y takes five days more than X to finish a work. Working together, they finish the work in six days. 

Concept used:

Total work = Work done each day × Number of days to finish
